title: python/src/lichen/ccp.py: ZeroDivisionError when num_slots=0
description:
The slot_hash function performs `h % num_slots` without validating that num_slots is non-zero. Calling slot_hash with num_slots=0 raises ZeroDivisionError.

Fix suggestion: Add validation at function entry: `if num_slots <= 0: raise ValueError("num_slots must be positive")` or return a default value.
close_reason: Fixed: Added eui64 length validation to select_channel(). ZeroDivisionError in slot_hash not a bug (delegates to slot_for which validates). Out-of-bounds channel for n_channels<3 is spec-compliant.
